{{Quote|Really? Adali always impressed me as something of a stoic. Then again, she is a widow now. Hmm&hellip;|Vernan|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Adali''' was a [[Gender/Legends|woman]] who was the wife of [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Soylon]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. When Soylon was killed by [[rakghoul]]s, Soylon's companion Doctor [[Vernan (scientist)|Vernan]] composed a death notice to send to Adali, who he considered to be a stoic.
